note: Reclassified 2026-07-10 by the setuptools-83 corpus re-verification (results/reverify-setuptools83.md). Recorded as 'pass', but the original proof was contaminated. setup.py rewrites win32ctypes/version.py at module top level, so merely executing setup.py -- which setuptools-py2cfg does during conversion -- mutates the source tree before the pristine baseline is snapshotted; both sides then matched. Re-verified from an untouched sdist, the pristine build regenerates version.py with LF while the pyproject-only build ships the sdist's CRLF copy verbatim, so payloads differ. Fails identically under setuptools 82.0.1 and 83.0.0, so this is a latent gate defect, not a setuptools regression. pywin32-ctypes generates code at build time and belongs in the refuse-loudly bucket; its unproven pyproject.toml has been withdrawn.
